jars: The phrase 'smaller picture of yourself' in Day 1 Insight is slightly vague and generic.
Day 7's 'keep your sandals' metaphor is a bit obscure and feels slightly detached from the modern UK Punjabi business context.
The Day 1 Go deeper practice suggests 'sit with your father in silence for one minute,' which is highly impractical for a man in his late 40s running a family business.
The Day 1 script asks 'Who in your family sees you as the adult you are?' which feels a bit like a therapy session question for a 47-year-old man.
best: Your years of running the business are that wealth. It is the knowledge you built, the decisions you made, the life you built while raising your children. Your father cannot see it and cannot take it.
day1_verdict: This actually gets it—it names the exact feeling of being undermined in your own workplace by your dad.
